It is essential to note that until the bishop publicly announces the appointments at the Annual Conference session, these appointments are not officially confirmed. Many Annual Conferences attempt to avoid making changes to appointments between Annual Conference sessions. Although appointments are made on a yearly basis, it is common for a clergy member to remain in the same position for multiple years.
